summary.text: Lisa Field is a Democratic state representative from Taunton who has represented the 3rd Bristol District since July 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She won the seat in a 2025 special election and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Field won the 2025 special general election for the 3rd Bristol District, defeating Lawrence Quintal, and assumed office on July 16, 2025.

She serves on the Joint Committees on Aging and Independence; Bonding, Capital Expenditures and State Assets; Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities; and Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure.
